Crypt prices are not shown on this page. The MIS crypt sheet supplied renders its price text four pixels tall, and at that size its font draws only eight distinct shapes for ten digits — a five-figure amount cannot be read from it with certainty, so no figure is printed here rather than a wrong one. A crypt marked Available does carry a printed price on the sheet; read the exact amount from MIS. The Radiance and Serenity niche-wall prices are legible and are exact. Open & Closing and Monobar print as ######## on the crypt sheet and are omitted from every total.
Recording Fee — $225applies to every crypt
Monobar Install Fee — $215 ea Qty:
Crypt Vase — $415 ea Qty:
Niche O&C — $875 ea Qty:
Niche Recording — $235 ea Qty:
E.C.F.10% — not included in listed prices
Niche Inscription none — glass-front niches carry no inscription fee
Niche Sales Tax none — glass-front niches are not taxed
Omitted (illegible on the sheet)Open & Closing · Monobar (each)
Tier G is the top row, tier A the bottom. Space numbers run 101–231 around the building.
A tandem or companion is ONE purchasable unit at one price and is never split.
51 crypt units marked available  ·  18 not selling  ·  27 niches available, $233,075 listed  ·  Prices effective January 13, 2025
